prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Pearland, Texas, and has shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1231; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the sideswipe collision you reported in Pearland, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just give my first name for now, if that's all right.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me, in your own words, what happened?

A: I was moving over into the left lane to get around a slow truck. I checked my mirror and didn't see anything, but when I was about halfway over, a car came up alongside me and clipped the side of my vehicle. It pushed me toward the median before I could correct.

Q: Were you signaling before you changed lanes?

A: Yes, I had my turn signal on for a few seconds before I moved.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle's signal or lights at any point?

A: No. It seemed to come out of my blind spot quickly. I don't think it had its headlights on, but it was getting dark, so I'm not certain.

Q: Did you stop after the contact?

A: I pulled onto the shoulder and stayed in the car for a minute. The other driver stopped a little ahead of me, and we exchanged information.

Q: Were you injured?

A: My right shoulder hurt right away. I felt a sharp pain when I grabbed the wheel to steady the car. I went to urgent care later that evening and they told me to follow up with my doctor.

Q: Have you had any prior injuries to that shoulder?

A: No, not that I can recall.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: Just that I'm willing to provide any records you need.
